name: 11220 · Brooklyn, NY
findings: ZIP 11220 (Brooklyn) has 214 nonprofit organizations. 82 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 65 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11220 (Brooklyn) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
